title: Website-Based Digitalization of Putro Agung Sports Field Management in Rangkah Subdistrict, Surabaya City
title_in: Digitalisasi Manajemen Lapangan Olahraga Putro Agung Berbasis Website di Kelurahan Rangkah Kota Surabaya
description: This activity aims to digitalize the management system of Putro Agung sports field through a website-based platform to improve administrative efficiency and service accessibility.

title: Enhancing Understanding of Machine Learning Implementation for Students of SMK Negeri 1 Bangil to Improve Competence in the Field of Information Technology Engineering
title_in: Peningkatan Pemahaman Implementasi Machine Learning bagi Siswa SMK Negeri 1 Bangil untuk Meningkatkan Kompetensi di Bidang Teknik Informatika
description: This activity aims to enhance students’ understanding of machine learning implementation in order to improve their competencies in the field of information technology engineering.

title: Improving the Mental Health of Indonesian Migrant Workers in Thailand: Screening, Support, and Education within a Single Technology Platform
title_in: Peningkatan Kesehatan Mental Pekerja Migran Indonesia di Thailand: Skrining, Dukungan, dan Edukasi dalam Satu Platform Teknologi
description: This program aims to improve the mental health of Indonesian migrant workers in Thailand through integrated screening, support, and educational services delivered via a single technology platform.
